title: Recording View
requirements: Implement RecordingView as modal sheet, not dismissible while recording
Implement RecordingViewModel @MainActor @Observable with liveTranscript, elapsed, isFinalizing
Start/Stop button toggle initiates recording via AudioRecorder
Live transcript updates word-by-word from SpeechTranscriber via AsyncStream
On Stop: show Finalizing until pipeline completes, then auto-dismiss
acceptance_criteria: Recording sheet cannot be dismissed while recording is active
Live transcript appears within 2 seconds of first speech
Sheet auto-dismisses within 1 second of pipeline completion
